This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and cone-shaped cranium. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least two members of this species were present in a [[Casino on Qiaxx|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiaxx]].<ref name="MJ5" />

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ5" />
